Saved equipment: exactly ONE halberd, a TWO-HANDED polearm with one continuous wooden/iron shaft, recognizable broad axe blade, rear hook and top spike. BOTH hands visibly grip this same shaft, one higher and one lower, in a raised guard poised to strike screen right. No shield or second weapon. Reserve transparent space on the RIGHT for the action halberd sweep, and above the head for the raised ready blade. All visible pixels must fit a 128x128 final PNG with transparent margin. Make crisp, readable pixel art with genuine transparent alpha; no black background, glow field, scenery, text, duplicate figure, diptych or second pose.
